reason: The spare solar modules are the available power source, and the prepared footing is the intended industrial site.

effect: The separate solar circuit completes the chapter's power goal while preserving the growing room's supply.
reaction: The explicit separation of industrial and growing-room power was a satisfying practical detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the solar modules was most worthwhile: it connected the return plan to a concrete power decision without taking power from the crops.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the footing was sensible but predictable; the excavator's earlier use made the choice straightforward.

surprise.text: The industrial supply uses a separate circuit, explicitly preserving the growing room's allotted power.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt particularly arbitrary; both followed clearly from the stated goals and available equipment.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the local-propellant contingency works and how the discovery reaches Earth, though this chapter offered only a brief start on that plan.
